resilience.statusHint: The breaker in front of each identity-provider connector. CLOSED = traffic flows; OPEN = calls are refused for the open period after too many failures; HALF-OPEN = trial calls in progress; DISABLED = protection off.
resilience.metrics: failure rate {{rate}} · {{failed}} failed of {{buffered}} recent calls · {{blocked}} refused while open
resilience.title: Protection policy
resilience.intro: Applied live to all identity-provider connectors the moment you save. Refused calls are answered with error 2103 “service temporarily unavailable” and are never charged.
resilience.breakerHint: When the failure rate over the recent calls crosses the threshold, the breaker opens and refuses calls for the open period, then lets a few trial calls through.
resilience.serviceOnlyHint: Recommended. “Not found”, “no match” and rejected input are correct answers, not outages — they should never open the breaker. Only transport errors, timeouts and provider 5xx count.
resilience.retryHint: Retries a call after a transient transport failure (connection error, timeout). Provider answers are never retried.

image.title: Fingerprint image validation
image.intro: Rules applied to every fingerprint image the API receives, before the bank is charged and before the request reaches the identity provider. Changes take effect within seconds.
image.offHint: Images are inspected for reporting only; nothing is rejected.
image.warnHint: Problems are recorded on the transaction but the call continues.
image.enforceHint: Problems reject the call with HTTP 400 · 1002 and no charge.
image.formatsHint: Container detected from the file header. Anything else is rejected.
image.dimensionsHint: Reject captures that are too small to match or implausibly large.
image.resolutionHint: Read from the WSQ NIST comment or the PNG pHYs chunk. Images that declare none pass unless required.
image.requirePpi: Reject if resolution is not declared
image.sizeEncodingHint: Decoded image size, WSQ compression ratio (raw pixels ÷ file bytes) and PNG colour depth.
image.blankHint: PNG only. Grey-level standard deviation (0–255); a real fingerprint is usually above 30, a blank capture near 0.
image.nfiq2Hint: NIST NFIQ 2 score from 0 (unusable) to 100 (excellent), measured by the platform's quality service on every PNG or WSQ that passes the rules above. Adds about half a second per verification. The ICD recommends a minimum of 40.
image.nfiq2FailOpen: If the quality service is down, let calls through (warn only)
image.coverageHint: PNG only. Share of 16×16 pixel blocks that contain ridge texture. A full plain impression is 60–90%; a partial, smudged or mostly empty capture is far lower.
image.checkCoverage: Reject partial or mostly empty captures
image.nfiq2RejectHint: An image below the minimum score is rejected (400 / 1002) with the quality message below.
image.nfiq2WarnOnlyHint: Scores are measured and stored on every transaction but never reject a call. Use this to observe a bank's captures before enforcing.
image.messagesHint: Banks get one plain sentence. The technical reason (resolution, format, score…) is kept on the transaction for your staff only.
image.qualityMessage: Poor capture (blank, partial, smudged, low score)
image.qualityMessageHint: The operator should re-capture the finger.
image.formatMessageHint: The bank's integration must be corrected.
image.returnScore: Share the quality score with the bank
image.returnScoreHint: Adds imageQuality (0–100) to successful responses and to quality rejections so the bank's app can guide the operator.

tenantQuality.title: Fingerprint quality threshold
tenantQuality.subtitle: Minimum NFIQ 2 score (0–100) accepted from this client. Different scanners score differently; leave the default unless this bank's captures need their own threshold.
tenantQuality.defaultHint: The platform-wide minimum from Settings → Fingerprint image applies.
tenantQuality.ownHint: Images scoring below {{min}} are rejected for this client, regardless of the platform default.
tenantQuality.minHint: Recommended 40. Lower it only after reviewing this bank's scores in Reports.
tenantQuality.error: Could not update the quality threshold
